verdicts.reason: Both make the same structural mistakes. The 'How It Works' CTA is moved above the headline, which breaks the reading order. The Meridian logo is pushed top-right and straddles the edge of the decorative white circle. The circle no longer frames the suitcase and instead sits behind the end of the headline, where 'four' runs into it. The legal text is tiny. A also has a tight 32px left margin and a smaller suitcase that leaves more dead space above the legal text. B has slightly better margins and a larger suitcase that fills the space better, but its legal text sits close to the bottom edge.
